entities.name: Treaty of Versailles
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The 1919 peace treaty that ended World War I between the Allied Powers and Germany. It imposed severe reparations, territorial losses, and military restrictions on Germany. Its perceived harshness contributed to political instability and the rise of Nazism.
